whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the devices in the list will be exposed. If empty, all devices are exposed.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The devices in the list will not be exposed.

devices.title: WiZ Devices
devices.description: List of WiZ devices to expose. Each needs a name and a LAN IP address.

type.title: Device Type
type.description: rgbcw = RGB + tunable white, cct = tunable white only, dimmable = white only, plug = smart plug

discovery.title: Auto Discovery
discovery.description: Discover WiZ devices via UDP broadcast on the LAN (requires host network).

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (s)
pollInterval.description: How often to poll device state over UDP.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown. Debug only.
